title: AI player character in Unreal with navigation actions and voice commands
author: Western_Bug_5085
selftext:
Hi everyone,

Our team at Convai has put together part one of an Unreal Engine Actions series for AI characters.

The character can follow the player, stop on command, and navigate to named objects in the scene. This first part covers basic navigation actions using pawn movement, nav mesh setup, and marked scene objects.

Full tutorial:  
[https://youtu.be/yWqJQRttoEI](https://youtu.be/yWqJQRttoEI)

Next parts will cover custom environmental interactions, parameterized actions, animation triggers, and more.

Would be interested to hear how AI game devs are approaching NPC actions, especially around voice commands, navigation, and runtime behavior.
